en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Orthodox cathedral with domes and crosses on the left, opening onto a very broad, tree‑lined square or boulevard with scattered pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and surrounding low buildings. Inset at the bottom right is a view of an obelisk‑like monument. Printed captions in Bulgarian (Cyrillic) and German identify the cathedral and send greetings from Varna.
